text: Check whether a customer has access/balance for a feature via API call
quote: const response = await autumn.check({ customerId: "user_123", featureId: "messages" });

text: Track usage events (e.g. messages sent) for a customer via API
Credit-based systems let multiple actions draw down a single shared credit balance at different costs
quote: Credit systems let you track actions with different credit costs from a single balance pool.

text: Supports pay-per-use pricing that bills customers based on actual feature consumption at period end
quote: Pay-per-use (usage-based) pricing charges customers based on how much of a feature they actually consume, billed at the end of each billing period.

text: Official CLI (atmn) lets you define pricing plans as code in a config file and sync them with one command
quote: The `atmn` CLI lets you define your pricing plans in code via an `autumn.config.ts` file, and sync them to Autumn with a single command.

text: CLI can preview pricing plan changes locally before pushing them live
quote: You can preview your plans without pushing anything: bunx atmn preview

text: Official MCP server exposes billing, customer, plan, balance, and log tools to AI assistants
quote: Autumn MCP connects AI assistants to Autumn's billing, customer, plan, balance, and log tools.

text: Webhook fires when a customer's subscription plan changes (new, upgrade, downgrade)
quote: Fired whenever a customer's plans change — new subscriptions, upgrades, downgrades, etc.

text: Usage alerts can be configured with a 'basis' defining what counts as 100% (balance, included grants, recurring grants, or usage limit)
quote: Usage alerts gain a `basis` field that defines what 100% means: the full `balance` (the default, unchanged), the plan’s `included` grants, `recurring` grants, or a `usage_limit` window

text: Catalog plans can reuse an existing Stripe product/price catalog instead of creating new Stripe objects
quote: Catalog plans now accept a `processors` object so Autumn can reuse your existing Stripe catalog instead of minting new objects.

text: CLI can pull existing dashboard-created products/plans down into local config file
quote: If you already have products created in the dashboard, run `atmn pull` to pull them into your local config.

text: Can atomically check and reserve balance in a single API call to safely handle concurrent usage events
quote: You can also [check and reserve] balance in a single, atomic API call for concurrent events.

text: Attaching a plan to a customer handles new subscriptions, upgrades, and downgrades automatically
quote: Attaches a plan to a customer. Handles new subscriptions, upgrades and downgrades.
